Case study · Hospitality Photography

Casa Verde: one shoot day, a 34% reservation lift

Replace every outdated image with a coherent set that shows the space at the hour people actually book for, and drive a measurable lift in direct reservations.

Client
Casa Verde
Year
2025
Timeline
3 visits + 1 shoot day + 5 days delivery
Services
5 delivered

Results

  • +34% Direct reservations
  • 2 Unsolicited press features
  • 96 Finished images

Full case study

01

The challenge

A renovated neighbourhood restaurant was still using photographs of its previous incarnation on the website and every third-party listing. The food looked fine; the room looked wrong. Direct reservations through the site were flat while delivery orders climbed.

02

The goal

Replace every outdated image with a coherent set that shows the space at the hour people actually book for, and drive a measurable lift in direct reservations.

03

Approach

  1. 01 Visited three times before shooting to map how light moves across the dining room through the day.
  2. 02 Shot the empty room at opening, the pass during service, and the terrace in the final hour of daylight.
  3. 03 Kept direction minimal so staff and diners appear natural rather than staged.
  4. 04 Delivered crops sized for the website, reservation platform, press submissions and social.
  5. 05 Tracked direct reservations against the previous two months as the primary metric.
04

Services provided

  • Location scout
  • Full-day shoot
  • Food & interiors
  • Retouching
  • Multi-channel crops
05

Results

Direct reservations through the website rose 34% over the following two months with no change in marketing spend. Two food publications ran the images unsolicited, and the same library is now serving the seasonal menu campaign.
